subjects.name: Computer Science and Information Technology
subjects.description: GATE 2027 CS paper — 10 syllabus sections. Lectures are hand-picked from YouTube (best Hinglish + best English per topic) with AI study notes.

units.name: Engineering Mathematics
units.syllabus: Discrete Mathematics, Linear Algebra, Calculus, Probability and Statistics.

units.name: Digital Logic
units.syllabus: Boolean algebra and minimization; combinational and sequential circuits; number representation and arithmetic.

units.name: Computer Organization and Architecture
units.syllabus: Instruction set, ALU and control unit design, memory hierarchy and cache mapping, I/O (interrupt, DMA), pipelining and hazards.

units.name: Programming and Data Structures
units.syllabus: Programming in C, recursion, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, BSTs, binary heaps, graphs.

units.name: Algorithms
units.syllabus: Searching, sorting, hashing; asymptotic complexity; greedy, dynamic programming, divide-and-conquer; graph traversals, MSTs, shortest paths.

units.name: Theory of Computation
units.syllabus: Regular expressions and finite automata; CFGs and PDAs; regular and context-free languages, pumping lemma; Turing machines and undecidability.

units.name: Compiler Design
units.syllabus: Lexical analysis, parsing, syntax-directed translation, runtime environments, intermediate code generation, local optimisation, data-flow analyses.

units.name: Operating System
units.syllabus: System calls, processes, threads, inter-process communication, concurrency and synchronization. Deadlock. CPU and I/O scheduling. Memory management and virtual memory. File systems.

units.name: Databases
units.syllabus: ER-model; relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL; integrity constraints, normal forms; file organization, indexing (B and B+ trees); transactions and concurrency control.

units.name: Computer Networks
units.syllabus: Layering; switching; data link layer, MAC, Ethernet; routing; IPv4, CIDR, NAT; TCP flow and congestion control, sockets; DNS and HTTP.
